From the judge's explanation

To both parties: the $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full.

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

  2. Independently of the geofence, the waiting period was never served. To both parties: the $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full. WHY THE FEE DOES NOT STAND. Under POL-NS-01 the fee is chargeable only if all four conditions hold; the arrival and waiting conditions fail. (1) Arrival — POL-NS-01(b) read through POL-NS-02. The driver is deemed to have arrived only where the gps_trace contains at least three consecutive fixes, each with reported horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. EV-GPS-00212 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, holds 93 fixes across the whole 08:05:10–08:20:30 window with 100% coverage and no gaps, and returns qualifying_fix_count 0 with a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds. There is no qualifying in-radius fix at any point, so POL-NS-02's own rule applies: the driver never arrived at the pickup point to the required standard and limb (b) fails. The driver's strongest point — that an unfiltered fix closes to 37.94 m, inside the 50 m radius — does not save the charge. That reading did not survive the 25 m accuracy filter, and POL-NS-02 provides that fixes worse than 25 m are count as evidence of neither presence nor absence while still directing that absent a qualifying in-radius fix the driver is not deemed to have arrived. The admissibility note itself says poor accuracy here is data, not a defect, and that the record simply cannot place the driver inside the geofence to POL-NS-02's standard; that is a policy failure, not an impairment discount. (2) Waiting period — POL-NS-01(c) and POL-NS-06. The free waiting period in force is 300 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, which governs the 180-second default). The effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds, a shortfall of 300 seconds. POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the driver's 'arrived' tap, and POL-NS-12's platform-confirmed route is unavailable because arrival_marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO. The 7.9-minute wait_time_min in the trip record is therefore the interval from the driver-pressed marker to cancellation and does not establish a served waiting period. POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full on this arithmetic alone. POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable: EV-ADVIS-00212-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so no traffic_advisory can be summed. CLAIMS ANSWERED.
